reason: I endorse this change. amendment/change.json alters only the THEN clause of the supported-disabled-action scenario: 'unavailable state and reason' becomes 'unavailable state and any reason required by the frozen per-surface policy'. candidates-v3.json line 1959 contains that exact text. The scenario now agrees with the ELM-ADOPT-030 EARS and its guardrails, which already make the reason policy-specific and avoid a universal rule across GTK and Windows/APG. Stable position, exposed native unavailable state and no dispatch on activation are all kept. all-disabled-and-focus-retirement is unchanged. Safety is not weakened: when the disabled state comes from a Pending, Refused or Unknown outcome, ELM-ADOPT-020 and ELM-ADOPT-011 still independently require the correlated reason and safe next step from the reviewed catalog, so this edit cannot hide Unknown. My limits: I checked only this changed field. I did not diff the other 29 contracts or the other scenarios against v2, and I did not compute either SHA256 because I had no shell. Both of those rest on the coordinator's statement. This is my vote alone; I do not infer consensus or speak for other reviewers. It implies no native acceptance, baseline expansion or product selection. I made no edits, ran no GUI and spawned no agents.
